approval_evidence.responds_to: Approve this organization and routing choice for implementation?
approval_evidence.binding_basis: Coordinator binds the exact frozen candidate presented immediately before the reply; no claim that the human recited the digest.

accepted_behavior: Affected installed-skill union nonempty: publish one notice on exact topic all.
Announceable unchanged-installed-content new release: keep skill-release topic and no-reload guidance.
Dedicated skill-release-only listeners must include all for changed notices; broadcast wake consequence was disclosed.
Preserve opt-out, same-current suppression, deploy-only publication, one attempt and unconfirmed-publication/exit2 behavior.
Compact relevance, actual instruction refresh, removed-guidance dependency, context continuity and authority/exposure guidance in coordination-channels.
accepted_organization: Retained Sol6.1/xhigh/default supervisor and two retained Terra/medium/default discovery implementers, plus a future fresh top-level Astra/high/default read-only reviewer owned by root.
implementation_authority: granted for the exact bounded scope, isolated qualification and bounded ordinary remediation
review_launch_authority: root may launch and retain the separately established Astra/high/default read-only reviewer for the composed implementation
revision_policy: Coordinator approves small consequence-preserving organization changes; human approves large changes, classified with reasons. Other owning boundaries retain precedence.
